title: AttestationEnvelope
description: A signed attestation (SEP §5.2): a document, the account that signed it, and the signature. The signature covers SHA-256("Stellar Signed Message:\n" + domain + "\n" + canonical JSON of payload), where canonical JSON is RFC 8785 and the domain is chosen by the verifier from what it expects to check - it is deliberately not a field of the envelope. This schema checks the envelope's shape only; it cannot check the signature. The payload is constrained here to "has an attester"; a contract event-schema payload is further described by attestation.schema.json.

v.description: Envelope version. A verifier rejects any other value.

attester.description: The attesting account (G…). Must equal publicKey.

signature.description: Standard base64 (with padding) of the 64-byte ed25519 signature.
